title: img-pan-zoom
description: Image viewer with pan and zoom, including Deep Zoom image support

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: image source

attributes.name: sources
attributes.description: array of image sources

attributes.name: page
attributes.description: if used with multiple images and paged navigation, index of current item

attributes.name: described-by
attributes.description: aria-describedby attribute

attributes.name: dzi
attributes.description: Set to true if you are using a deep zoom image

attributes.name: fade-in
attributes.description: Fade in new items added to the viewer

attributes.name: fullscreen-toggled
attributes.description: whether fullscreen mode is toggled

attributes.name: flip-toggled
attributes.description: whether images is flipped horizontally

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: loading

attributes.name: hide-spinner
attributes.description: hides spinner

attributes.name: loaded
attributes.description: loaded

attributes.name: show-navigation-control
attributes.description: Set to false to prevent the appearance of the default navigation controls. Note that if set to false, the customs buttons set by the options zoomInButton, zoomOutButton etc, are rendered inactive.

attributes.name: show-navigator
attributes.description: Set to true to make the navigator minimap appear.

attributes.name: zoom-per-click
attributes.description: The "zoom distance" per mouse click or touch tap. Note: Setting this to 1.0 effectively disables the click-to-zoom feature (also see gestureSettings[Mouse|Touch|Pen].clickToZoom/dblClickToZoom).

attributes.name: zoom-per-scroll
attributes.description: The "zoom distance" per mouse scroll or touch pinch. Note: Setting this to 1.0 effectively disables the mouse-wheel zoom feature (also see gestureSettings[Mouse|Touch|Pen].scrollToZoom}).

attributes.name: animation-time
attributes.description: Specifies the animation duration per each OpenSeadragon.Spring which occur when the image is dragged or zoomed.

attributes.name: nav-prev-next-wrap
attributes.description: If true then the 'previous' button will wrap to the last image when viewing the first image and the 'next' button will wrap to the first image when viewing the last image.

attributes.name: show-rotation-control
attributes.description: If true then the rotate left/right controls will be displayed as part of the standard controls. This is also subject to the browser support for rotate (e.g. viewer.drawer.canRotate()).

attributes.name: min-zoom-image-ratio
attributes.description: The minimum percentage ( expressed as a number between 0 and 1 ) of the viewport height or width at which the zoom out will be constrained. Setting it to 0, for example will allow you to zoom out infinity.

attributes.name: max-zoom-pixel-ratio
attributes.description: The maximum ratio to allow a zoom-in to affect the highest level pixel ratio. This can be set to Infinity to allow 'infinite' zooming into the image though it is less effective visually if the HTML5 Canvas is not availble on the viewing device.

attributes.name: constrain-during-pan
attributes.description: Constrain during pan

attributes.name: visibility-ratio
attributes.description: The percentage ( as a number from 0 to 1 ) of the source image which must be kept within the viewport. If the image is dragged beyond that limit, it will 'bounce' back until the minimum visibility ratio is achieved. Setting this to 0 and wrapHorizontal ( or wrapVertical ) to true will provide the effect of an infinitely scrolling viewport.

attributes.name: navigator-auto-fade
attributes.description: whether navigator fades when image is not longer being moved

attributes.name: navigator-position
attributes.description: where navigator is positioned: "TOP_LEFT", "BOTTOM_RIGHT", "ABSOLUTE", etc. Default is "TOP_RIGHT"

attributes.name: navigator-top
attributes.description: if navigator position is "ABSOLUTE", top position for navigator

attributes.name: navigator-bottom
attributes.description: if navigator position is "ABSOLUTE", bottom position for navigator

attributes.name: navigator-left
attributes.description: if navigator position is "ABSOLUTE", left position for navigator

attributes.name: navigator-right
attributes.description: if navigator position is "ABSOLUTE", right position for navigator

attributes.name: navigator-height
attributes.description: height of navigator

attributes.name: navigator-width
attributes.description: width of navigator

attributes.name: navigator-toggled
attributes.description: whether navigator window mode is toggled

attributes.name: sequence-mode
attributes.description: displays multiple images as a sequence

attributes.name: preserve-viewport
attributes.description: preserves viewport when navigating images in sequence mode See https://openseadragon.github.io/examples/tilesource-sequence/

attributes.name: show-reference-strip
attributes.description: show reference strip for images in sequence mode. See https://openseadragon.github.io/examples/ui-reference-strip/

attributes.name: reference-strip-scroll
attributes.description: orientation of images using reference strip; can be 'horizontal' or 'vertical' (default)

attributes.name: previousButton
attributes.description: id of custom previousButton

attributes.name: nextButton
attributes.description: id of custom nextButton

attributes.name: homeButton
attributes.description: id of custom homeButton

attributes.name: zoomInButton
attributes.description: id of custom zoomInButton

attributes.name: zoomOutButton
attributes.description: id of custom zoomInButton

attributes.name: fullScreenButton
attributes.description: id of custom zoomInButton
